channel.title: Hastings Daily: On this day
channel.description: Local news for Hastings, St Leonards, Rye, Bexhill and Battle, three times a day.

item.title: On this day, 1823: New town hall market opens in the High Street
item.description: On 25 October 1823, the new town hall in the High Street opened its ground floor to the market traders, with 14 stalls taking up their positions.

item.title: On this day, 1944: Hastings' secret evacuation plans revealed
item.description: On Saturday 21 October 1944, the Hastings and St Leonards Observer printed what the town had not been allowed to know during the war: the full story of the secret plans to evacuate the whole borough in the event of a German invasion.
